name: Dedham
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Dedham, MA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Dedham, MA: the Dedham Square Holiday Stroll and tree lighting with Santa, model trains at the Dedham Museum, and calls from Santa.
lede: Dedham's Christmas centers on Dedham Square, where the Holiday Stroll brings Santa, a tree lighting and model trains at the town museum on the same night.
celebrates: Dedham Square Circle's Holiday Stroll and Gift Market is the big night, with Santa lighting the town tree, crafts for kids, a snowflake scavenger hunt and more than 50 vendors. Down High Street, the Dedham Museum and Archive sets up its holiday model trains. The Community House sells trees and wreaths at 671 High Street, the library puts up Giving Trees, and the Youth Commission runs a holiday giving program. Parks and Recreation arranges phone calls from Santa, and Chabad holds a menorah car parade that ends at Town Hall.
lastyear: In 2025 the Dedham Square Holiday Stroll ran on Friday, December 5, from 5 to 8 pm, with the tree lighting at 6:30 pm, according to the Town of Dedham's holiday guide. The museum's model trains ran free during the stroll and again the next day. The guide also listed tree and wreath sales at the Community House, Giving Trees at the library and Calls from Santa on December 17 and 18 for children ages 2 to 12.
facts: Dedham Square Circle says more than 2,000 people come out for its Holiday Stroll. The Dedham Museum and Archive runs O scale model trains for the stroll, with Lionel and MTH locomotives, a snowy main street and a tiny musical carousel. At the 2025 stroll, the town honored retired Fire Chief William Spillane at the tree lighting. Santa's phone calls through Dedham Parks and Recreation are for children ages 2 to 12.
trains: Dedham has two stops on the MBTA Franklin/Foxboro Line: Endicott and Dedham Corporate Center. Dedham Square Circle lists both stations and the MBTA 34E bus as ways to reach the Holiday Stroll. Trains run to South Station in Boston. For train fans, the Dedham Museum and Archive brings out its model trains each December, and Edaville in Carver runs holiday train rides through its lights.

kidfact: Every December, the Dedham Museum runs toy trains past a tiny snowy main street, and Santa comes to watch them.
faq: When is the Dedham Holiday Stroll?

Dedham Square Circle holds the Holiday Stroll on a Friday evening in early December in Dedham Square. In 2025 it ran from 5 to 8 pm, with Santa lighting the town tree at 6:30 pm. The stroll is free, with crafts, music, a scavenger hunt and a gift market with more than 50 vendors.
Where can kids see model trains in Dedham?

The Dedham Museum and Archive at 612 High Street sets up its holiday model trains during the Holiday Stroll. The museum runs O scale locomotives past a snowy main street and a miniature carousel, and it has kept the trains free. Santa has visited the trains on the Saturday after the stroll.
Can Santa call my child in Dedham?

Yes. Dedham Parks and Recreation runs Calls from Santa for children ages 2 to 12. In 2025 the calls went out on December 17 and 18. Parents sign up through Parks and Recreation, and the 2026 brochure lists the program as free, so check the department's page for sign up dates.
Where should I park for the Dedham Holiday Stroll?

High Street closes to traffic during the stroll, so use a free town lot. Dedham Square Circle lists the Keystone Lot at 10 Eastern Avenue, the Town Hall lot at 450 Washington Street, and the Upper and Lower Gonzalez lots. Endicott station on the commuter rail is another option.
